title: Response compaction manifest
description: Says, per field of a tool result, what a client may cut when the result is over its token budget. Lives at Tool._meta["io.modelcontextprotocol/response-compaction"]. See spec/response-compaction.md. Unknown top-level members are allowed and must be ignored, so later versions can add optional members.

fields.description: Map from a path to a policy. A path is a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901). The segment * matches every array element and every object member. The empty path "" is the whole value.
